english.note: Use 級數 when comparing whether people or things are on the same level, as in being out of someone’s league.
Use this for a quality rating or a position on a ranked scale rather than an unranked degree.

examples.english: You and him are simply not in the same league.
examples.traditional: 你同佢根本唔係同一個級數。
examples.jyutping: nei5 tung4 keoi5 gan1 bun2 m4 hai6 tung4 jat1 go3 kap1 sou3

examples.english: This restaurant is of a really high grade.
